subgoals.objective_name: To ensure that information receives an appropriate level of protection in accordance with its importance to the organization.
subgoals.goal_name: Ensure that information receives an appropriate level of protection in accordance with its importance to the organization

subgoals.control_name: Information shall be classified in terms of legal requirements, value, criticality and sensitivity to unauthorised disclosure or modification.

subgoals.goal_name: Classify information in terms of legal requirements, value, criticality and sensitivity to unauthorised disclosure or modification

subgoals.control_name: An appropriate set of procedures for information labelling shall be developed and implemented in accordance with the information classification scheme adopted by the organization.

subgoals.goal_name: Develop an appropriate set of procedures for information labelling
Implement an appropriate set of procedures for information labelling in accordance with the information classification scheme adopted by the organization

subgoals.control_name: Procedures for handling assets shall be developed and implemented in accordance with the information classification scheme adopted by the organization.

subgoals.goal_name: Implement procedures for handling assets in accordance with the information classification scheme adopted by the organization
